title: The Sharp Asset
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: Marguerite Amberdale, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
